title: A/P Unpaid Invoices: 101 bills count and add up before all are shown
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have a new vendor (created for this test), vendor A, with exactly 101 unpaid bills of $10.00 each, all overdue on today's date.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/P Unpaid Invoices (Reports, then "A/P Unpaid Invoices" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu; the page title reads "A/P Unpaid Invoices Report").
  • Leave the report with only vendor A ticked in the Vendor filter.
custom_steps:
1. Read vendor A's group row and the Totals row.
  2. Expand vendor A's group.
  3. Scroll down to the end of vendor A's bills.
  4. Choose "Download (CSV)" from the ⋯ menu.
  5. Open the CSV.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Vendor A's count reads 101.
  • Its Amount and Open Balance read $1,010.00 (101 × $10.00).
  • The Totals row's Open Balance reads $1,010.00.

Step 2:

  • The group opens with its first 100 bills.
  • The Totals row still reads $1,010.00: it covers all 101 bills, not only those shown.

Step 3:

  • The 101st bill loads, and every bill is listed once.

Step 4:

  • The CSV downloads.

Step 5:

  • It has 101 bill rows and one Totals row reading 1010.00.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 11 (5 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 10 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11531 (Story 1, Reports open in QuickBooks name order), story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV), story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S1-R8: “A/R Summary, A/P Summary, A/R Collection and A/P Unpaid Invoices show 30 customers or vendors at a time, and the next 30 load as the user scrolls down, as today. There are no page buttons. A/R Detail and A/P Detail show each bucket's first 100 lines, then load more as the user scrolls (S4-R4). Paging never repeats or skips a customer, vendor or row, in any sort. On A/R Collection and A/P Unpaid Invoices, an open customer or vendor shows its first 100 documents, then the next 100 as the user scrolls; its document count, its subtotals, the Totals row and the exports always cover all of its documents.”
  • S5-R18: “The Totals row always adds up exactly the rows the filters leave (customer or vendor, Past due, Location), on screen on every page, in the PDF and in the CSV. On A/R Collection and A/P Unpaid Invoices this fixes today's Totals row, which ignores the customer or vendor filter.”
  • S3-R8: “The CSV starts with the lines of S3-R5, each in its own row, in this order: As of, Locations, then Past due and the customer or vendor line only when set. The column heading row follows directly, then one flat table: one row per customer or vendor (Summaries) or per document (Detail, Collection, Unpaid Invoices), with the aging bucket, customer or vendor in its own column; no group header or subtotal rows; one Totals row at the bottom. Money is a plain number with two decimals, and an empty bucket is a blank cell; dates are YYYY-MM-DD.”

Not yet checked against a build: the QA build v26.45.2-6a8b89c exists since 10 Nov 2026 and this case has not been run on it yet.
